results.snippet: Over the past few months, Algeria has re-established diplomatic relations with junta-ruled Mali and launched its first overseas military mission since 1973—dispatching forces to Niger. This return to an active presence in the Sahel region is aimed at rebuilding its influence, which has been weakened in recent years.
